findings.evidence: analyzers/AgentGuard.Analyzers.Tests/NoLiteralFakeRootAnalyzerTests.cs:13 still reads "<c>home</c>/<c>currentDirectory</c>/<c>tempDirectory</c> argument of <c>AgentGuard.TestHelpers.FakeEnvironment.Create</c>" while NoLiteralFakeRootAnalyzer.cs:47-48 now carries `"home", "currentDirectory", "tempDirectory", "baseDirectory"` and its own summary, description, and the new LiteralNamedBaseDirectory_IsReported test were all updated. Doc drift only; the rule and its coverage are correct.

findings.summary: The contract and the AG0039 description both claim the ban applies "in ALL assemblies (production and test), with no owner exemption", but the build wiring makes it impossible for AG0039 to fire in two of the repo's assemblies.
findings.evidence: Contract line 100 and NoCallerFilePathAnalyzer.cs:52. Directory.Build.props wires the custom analyzers under `<ItemGroup Label="Custom analyzer wiring" Condition="'$(AgentGuardIsAnalyzerProject)' != 'true'">`, and both analyzers/AgentGuard.Analyzers/AgentGuard.Analyzers.csproj:7 and analyzers/AgentGuard.Analyzers.Tests/AgentGuard.Analyzers.Tests.csproj:5 set that property true. The claim is true of the analyzer's own logic (no CompilationStart gate, no owner exemption — I verified it fires in a production-named assembly via NoCallerFilePathAnalyzerTests.CallerFilePathInProductionAssembly_IsReported and in a real build of tests/AgentGuard.Tests), but the enforcement reads stronger than it is. No live gap: grep found no [CallerFilePath] in either analyzer project. Pre-existing wiring shared by every AG rule, not introduced here.

findings.summary: A raw AppContext.BaseDirectory call survives in the repo despite the contract's flat MUST NOT against it anywhere outside EnvironmentAdapter — the contract contradicts itself on this file.
findings.evidence: analyzers/AgentGuard.Analyzers.Tests/RepositoryFiles.cs:27 — `for (DirectoryInfo? directory = new(AppContext.BaseDirectory); …)`. Contract MUST NOT line 65 says "Call raw AppContext.BaseDirectory or AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory anywhere outside EnvironmentAdapter", while the Reuse ledger line 47 deliberately leaves RepositoryFiles.FindRepositoryRoot() untouched. Pre-existing, not introduced or touched by this diff, and in a project the custom analyzers are not wired into — so AG0011 could not have caught it. Recorded so the contradiction is not read as the diff's doing.
